Either these blocks are tagged as transparent for some reason (you can check via F3), there's holes in their collision geometry (doesn't have an easy way to check), or most likely another mod is breaking things. Try a binary search to find the offending mod, it is a simple process: 1) Remove half your mods 2) Try to reproduce the issue 3) If you can, repeat from 1); otherwise, remove all mods, add back the mods removed in 1), then repeat from 1)
